# MANOVIK AI (full)

> MANOVIK AI is an autonomous AI agent that codes in any language, builds websites, apps, and APIs, and works for you 24/7.

## What it is

MANOVIK AI is an autonomous AI agent that plans, builds and ships websites, apps and APIs. It is a streaming, polyglot coding agent with reasoning, private threads, and rich markdown output. It codes in any major language — JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Kotlin, SQL and more.

Key capabilities (from the product site):

- Build full-stack apps: MANOVIK scaffolds the UI, wires the database, and ships auth — all from one prompt.
- Spin up production APIs: REST or RPC endpoints, typed validators, rate-limits and logs included.
- MANOVIK FORCE: run parallel AI agent swarms on one brief.
- MANOVIK CLI: the AI coding agent in your terminal, with self-fixing CI.
- Holo Deck: virtual screens; Gesture Deck: gesture controls; Smart Home: smart-home control in Jarvis mode.
- Device Agent: pair phones and other devices; Location Tracker: device location.
- MCP support: MANOVIK connects to MCP servers, and ships its own MCP server endpoint at /mcp.
- Self-hosting: the Sovereign plan includes the self-host setup wizard, Docker support, and BYOK (bring your own key).
- Voice: MANO voice assistant with barge-in and echo suppression.

## Pricing

- Free tier: start building without a card.
- MANOVIK AI Pro: 800 messages with one-time payment, for builders shipping daily. Price: 699 INR (one-time payment, not a subscription).
- MANOVIK AI Sovereign (Lifetime Self-Host): run MANOVIK on your own infrastructure forever. One-time payment. Price: 4999 INR. Includes the self-host setup wizard, Docker support, and BYOK.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is MANOVIK AI?
A: MANOVIK is an autonomous AI agent that codes, builds, and ships software for you.

Q: Which languages does it support?
A: Any major language — JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Kotlin, SQL and more.

Q: Can I run MANOVIK on my own server?
A: Yes. The Sovereign lifetime plan (₹4999) includes the self-host setup wizard, Docker support, and BYOK.

Q: Is my data private?
A: Threads are encrypted at rest and never used to train third-party models.
